scripts.text:
[Akagi]
Hmmm...
You must have come,
sensing that someone
is waiting for you here.
Tell me, do you seek
the path of patience?
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
嗯...
你一定是察觉到有人在这里等你，才过来的吧。
告诉我，你是否在追寻忍耐之道？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不是

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Akagi]
I see.
To each his own,
I suppose. Take
care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
我明白了。
人各有志吧。
保重。

scripts.text:
[Akagi]
Very well.
Then, let me
set you on that
path right away...
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
很好。
那就让我即刻引你踏上这条路...

scripts.text:
[Akagi]
Hm? I cannot be
of any service to
you until you grow
a little stronger...
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
嗯？等你再强一些，我才能帮你...

scripts.text:
[Akagi]
Hmm...
You and I...
We are fairly equal in
terms of combat ability.
Perhaps we can spar
together sometime.
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
嗯...
你我实力相当。
或许哪天可以切磋一下。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
I... I've never
seen a baby as
powerful as you!
G-get away, you
freak of nature!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
我...我从没见过这么强的婴儿！
走...走开，你这个怪胎！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Hm? Have you come to
learn how to be a Ninja?
You're not quite experienced
enough yet, so come back
after you're more familiar
with fighting monsters.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
嗯？你是来学习忍术的吗？
你的经验还不够，等你更熟悉与魔物战斗，再来吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me.
H-hello?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下。
你...你好？

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
...............................
How did you do that?

[{0}]
Do what? I didn't
do anything, I don't think...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
做什么？我好像什么都没做啊...

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
H-How are you able to
see me? I'm supposed to
be invisible to the naked eye.
Ah, now I get it. Wildcat Joe
must have sent you to kill me! I won't fall for your tricks! Die!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
你...你怎么能看见我？
我应该是肉眼看不见的啊。
啊，我明白了！一定是野猫乔派你来杀我的！
我才不会上当！受死吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W-wait! I-I don't even
know who Wildcat Joe is!
Calm down, there's no
need to get violent!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等...等等！我...我连野猫乔是谁都不知道！
冷静点，没必要动手啊！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
What...?
How did you dodge
all of my attacks?
You've got some talent,
I'll give you that.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
什么...？
你竟然躲开了我所有的攻击？
不得不承认，你确实有些天赋。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...............................
I came here hoping
to change my job
to a Ninja.

[Kuuga Gai]
...Oh. Is that all?
Hmm, you've got great
potential, but I can't help
you now. I've got too many
enemies, and I can't let my
guard down for even a second.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
...哦，就这事？
嗯，你很有潜力，但我现在帮不了你。
我的敌人太多，一刻也不能放松警惕。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
That Wildcat Joe is
completely ruthless...!
He could strike at any time!
He'll do anything to achieve
victory over his enemies!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
那个野猫乔心狠手辣...！
他随时可能出手！
为了打败敌人，他什么手段都用得出来！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Wait, wait, I just
thought of something.
Maybe you can help me out.
Do what I ask, and I'll teach
you a few of my skills if you
really want to be a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
等等，等等，我想到个办法。
也许你能帮我。
如果你真想成为忍者，就照我说的做，我会教你几招。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Hm? Well, alright.
Still, I don't see
why we can't help
each other in this
little predicament...
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
嗯？那好吧。
不过，眼下这点麻烦，咱们互相帮忙不就解决了吗...

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Great! Now, I wanted to
ask Wildcat Joe if he'd
agree to a temporary truce.
I'm aware that both of us
are out of weapons, so we
should get well equipped first.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
太好了！我想问问野猫乔，愿不愿意暂时休战。
据我所知，我们俩都没武器了，得先补充装备。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Please take this letter,
and deliver it to Wildcat
Joe in Einbroch. He's a master
of disguise, so keep a careful
eye out for him. Ah, and look
for him in a high place.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
拿着这封信，交给艾音布罗克的野猫乔。
他是个伪装高手，找的时候得留心。
啊，对了，去高处找他。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Yeah, Wildcat Joe
always did have a thing
for hiding in high places.
Anyway, after you give him
the letter, come back and
let me know his answer.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
没错，野猫乔一直喜欢藏在高处。
把信交给他后，就回来告诉我他的答复。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Even if this task
isn't that urgent,
please hurry over to
Einbroch and deliver
my letter to Wildcat Joe.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
虽然这事不算特别急，还是请你尽快去艾音布罗克，把信交给野猫乔。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Did you deliver that
letter to Wildcat Joe?
I still need to know his
response to my proposal
for a truce. Anyway, see
if you can needle him for it.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
信交给野猫乔了吗？
我还等着他对休战提议的答复呢。
总之，去催催他吧。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Ah, you've returned.
So did Wildcat Joe send
you back here with his
response? Great, great,
please let me read it.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
啊，你回来了。
野猫乔让你带回了答复？
太好了，快给我看看。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
What...?! How could he
reject my proposal for
a truce?! This can only
mean that he's made another
Kunai. Nuts! I have to catch
up to him, or I'm a goner!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
什么...？！他竟然拒绝休战？！
这只能说明，他又做出苦无了。
该死！我得赶紧跟上，不然就完了！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Listen, you've got to help
me out again! I need you to
gather some materials so that
I can craft my own Kunai to fight Wildcat Joe. Then, I'll go ahead
and change your job to a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
听着，你得再帮我一次！
去收集些材料，我要打造自己的苦无，对付野猫乔。
然后，我就让你转职为忍者。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
All you need
to bring me is
^3355FF5 Cyfars^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000.
Please get those
as quickly as you can!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
只需要带来^3355FF5个赛依伐^000000和^3355FF1个强化武器金属-级数一^000000。
越快越好！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? That's funny,
Wildcat Joe actually
asked me to gather
those same materials.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？这就怪了，野猫乔也让我收集同样的材料。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Curses! Then that means...
You actually helped Joe
in crafting his Kunai! No!
I should have thought about
that earlier! Well, it's too
late now. Just h-hurry it up!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
该死！这么说...
你居然帮乔做出了苦无！不！
我早该想到的！
算了，现在说什么都晚了，快...快去！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Hurry and bring
^3355FF5 Cyfars^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000 to me,
so that I can craft
my own Kunai to use
against Wildcat Joe!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
快带来^3355FF5个赛依伐^000000和^3355FF1个强化武器金属-级数一^000000，我要打造自己的苦无，对付野猫乔！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Whoa, whoa...
You still have some
leftover Skill Points.
You'd better spend all
of them before you
change jobs, right?
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
等等，等等...
你还有没分配的技能点。
转职之前，得先把它们用完，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Ah, you're back with
everything that I need.
You've come earlier than
I expected, eh? Great,
as promised, I'll turn
you into a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
啊，需要的东西都带回来了。
比我预想的还快啊！
很好，按约定，我会让你转职为忍者。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Let me formally introduce
myself. I am High Ninja Kuuga Gai
in the Touga Ninja Corps, and
I'm in charge of the search
party to find Sir Kazma.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
正式介绍一下，我是土加忍者军团的上忍空牙·盖，负责率领寻找卡兹马大人的搜查队。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Sir Kazma is the chief
of my village, but he's
run away. This has resulted
in an internal conflict within
the Ninja Corps. Things are
pretty unstable right now...
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
卡兹马大人是我们村子的首领，可他出走了。
这导致忍者军团内部起了纷争，眼下局势很不稳定...

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
I initially didn't want to
accept you as a Ninja because
of this complicated situation.
However, you've proven that
you're truly worthy of joining
the Ninja ranks.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
正因为局势复杂，我起初不想收你做忍者。
不过，你已经证明自己确实有资格加入我们。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
According to his letter, even
Joe thinks highly of you. Just
remember that, as a Ninja, your
mission is your highest priority. But don't let mission objectives
supersede your conscience.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
从回信来看，连乔也很看好你。
记住，身为忍者，要把任务放在首位。
但绝不能为了完成任务，违背自己的良心。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
''Secrecy above all else.''
To keep our secrets in the
shadows, you can only buy
or sell Ninja weapons with
authorized dealers. Please
keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
“保密高于一切。”
为了不泄露我们的秘密，你只能与指定商人买卖忍者武器。
务必记住。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
As of today, you are
now a proud member of the
Touga Ninja Corps. Be as
agile as the wind, and as
quiet as the falling shadows.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
从今天起，你就是土加忍者军团光荣的一员。
行动如疾风，潜行如暗影。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
How have you been?
Train hard: you want
to be able to vanish
without a trace. If you
can do that, you'll get
the respect of any Ninja~
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
最近怎么样？
努力修炼，要做到来去无踪。
能做到这一点，就能赢得所有忍者的尊重~

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
How have you been?
Train hard: you want
to be able to vanish
without a trace. If you
can do that, you'll get
the respect of any Ninja~
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
最近怎么样？
努力修炼，要做到来去无踪。
能做到这一点，就能赢得所有忍者的尊重~

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
What...?
How were you able
to find me hidden
in the shadows?!
You must be more than
a common adventurer, eh?
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
什么...？
我藏在阴影里，你怎么还能找到我？！
看来你不是普通的冒险者啊。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
I've traveled to many
countries, but I've never
been on a building as high
as Einbroch Tower. All the
buildings in my hometown
are tiny in comparison...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
我游历过许多国家，却从没登上过像艾音布罗克中央塔这么高的建筑。
相比之下，家乡的建筑都显得很矮小...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, are you from
Amatsu? I'm looking
for someone named
Wildcat Joe from there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，你来自樱花城吗？
我正在找那里的一个人，叫野猫乔。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
...No. No, I'm actually
from Izlude, and I'm only
here in Einbroch for some
minerals. Tell me, why are
you looking for this Wildcat Joe?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
...不，不，我其实来自依斯鲁得岛，只是来艾音布罗克找些矿石。
你为什么要找这个野猫乔？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I need to deliver
this letter to him and
get his response so that
I can become a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我得把这封信交给他，再带回他的答复，才能成为忍者。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Really? Now that I think
about it, I do think that I've
run once or twice into him
in this town. Though, he prefers to be called ''Red Leopard Joe,''
instead of ''Wildcat Joe.''
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
是吗？这么一想，我好像确实在城里遇见过他一两次。
不过，比起“野猫乔”，他更喜欢别人叫他“红豹 乔”。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I really want to help you
find him, but first I need
to find the minerals that
I'm looking for. If you don't
mind, would you help me?
Then I can help you find Joe.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我倒是很想帮你找他，可得先找到我要的矿石。
如果不介意，能帮我个忙吗？
这样我就能帮你找乔了。

scripts.text: Don't worry, I'll find him alone.
scripts.translation: 不用担心，我自己找

scripts.text: Sure, I'll help you.
scripts.translation: 好，我帮你

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
You sure about that...?
Red Leopard Joe is a true
master of disguise. You'll
need all the help you can
get to find him...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
你确定...？
红豹 乔可是个真正的伪装高手。
想找到他，你得尽可能找人帮忙...

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Great, I'm glad to
hear that. Please
help me find
^3355FF5 Cyfars^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
太好了！请帮我找来^3355FF5个赛依伐^000000和^3355FF1个强化武器金属-级数一^000000。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Please bring
^3355FF5 Cyfars^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000 to me as
soon as you can. Then,
I can help you find
Red Leopard Joe.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
请尽快带来^3355FF5个赛依伐^000000和^3355FF1个强化武器金属-级数一^000000。
然后，我就能帮你找红豹 乔。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Good, good. You've
brought the minerals...
Now, it's my turn to
help you now. Here,
let me see that letter.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
很好，很好，矿石带来了...
现在轮到我帮你了，把那封信给我看看。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Why? Didn't you bring Kuuga Gai's letter for me?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
怎么了？你不是给我带了空牙·盖的信吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you...
Are you Wildcat Joe?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你...你就是野猫乔？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
...Yes, but I prefer to
be called Red Leopard Joe.
Kuuga Gai sent you to me, right?
He's the only one who calls
me that. So you want to be
a Ninja, eh? Hmm, alright.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
...没错，不过我更喜欢“红豹 乔”这个名字。
是空牙·盖让你来的吧？只有他才那样叫我。
你想成为忍者，是吗？嗯，好吧。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
If you want to be a Ninja,
you should always be careful
of what you see and what you trust. Don't forget that if your
secrets are ever discovered, then you're finished as a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
想成为忍者，就要时刻警惕，不要轻信眼前所见。
记住，秘密一旦暴露，你的忍者生涯就结束了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Remember to move
quickly, and to always
vanish without a trace.
To remain hidden in the
shadows is really our
ultimate power.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
记住，行动要快，隐去时不能留下任何痕迹。
藏身于暗影之中，才是我们最强大的力量。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
For now, let me read
this letter. Let's see...
Hm. I thought that Kuuga Gai
would want to challenge me
again, but he actually wants
a temporary truce? Hah!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
先让我看看这封信吧...
嗯，我还以为空牙·盖又想挑战我，没想到他居然想暂时休战？哈！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Thanks to your help,
I now have the minerals
I need to construct a Kunai!
Hahaha! I won't agree to a truce when I have the advantage!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
多亏你帮忙，我已经凑齐了打造苦无的矿石！
哈哈哈！既然占了上风，我怎么会同意休战！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Anyway, let me write my
response to him. I'll also
give you my recommendation...
I think you'll make a very fine
Ninja, even if I did trick you
just earlier. Heh heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
总之，我先给他写封回信，也会向他推荐你...
虽然你刚才被我骗了，但我觉得，你会成为一个很出色的忍者。
嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Here you go.
Please bring this
letter to Kuuga Gai.
It'll take a while to
return to Amatsu, so let
me send you there directly...
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
给，把这封信交给空牙·盖。
回樱花城还要花些时间，我就直接送你过去吧...

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Eh? I'm not sure what
happened, but it seems
that you haven't delivered
my response to Kuuga Gai yet.
Shall I directly send you
to Amatsu right now?
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
咦？不知道出了什么事，你好像还没把我的回信交给空牙·盖。
要我现在直接送你去樱花城吗？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不了，谢谢

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好，麻烦你了

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Alright. Well, I was
just trying to save
you some time.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
好吧，我只是想替你省点时间。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Okay, then.
Goodbye for now.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
好，那就先告别了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Kuuga Gai asked you to
gather some materials
too? Oh well, I suppose
that I can't blame him.
Besides, I should be able
to beat him in a fair fight~
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
空牙·盖也让你收集材料？
算了，倒也不能怪他。
反正公平交手，我也能打败他~

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Oh, you're a Ninja~
I hope you continue to
train yourself and master
all the Ninja skills that
you can. Always remember
to blend into the shadows.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
哦，你已经是忍者了~
希望你继续修炼，尽可能掌握各种忍术。
别忘了，时刻融入暗影之中。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I've traveled to many
countries, but I've never
been on a building as high
as Einbroch Tower. All the
buildings in my hometown
are tiny in comparison...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我游历过许多国家，却从没登上过像艾音布罗克中央塔这么高的建筑。
相比之下，家乡的建筑都显得很矮小...
